headline: Existing trays flood at 1.25× — re-tray passes
summary: Calibrated model PV1767-base-check floods at 0.847 / 0.85 (99.6 %) already; at the 125 % feed proxy (115 000 kg/h, today’s 64.1 mol % ≈62.4 wt % ethylene) the same reflux floods at 1.059 / 0.85 = 124.6 % in the rectifying/pasteurization section (PV1767-125-scaled-spec). Re-tray with high-capacity/high-efficiency internals in the same 16 ft shell (tray_capacity_factor 1.85, efficiency 0.88) keeps flood at 0.744 / 0.85 = 87.5 % and keeps polymer-grade purity at +25 % ethylene (PV1767-revamp-test-1).

request:
Engineering loop, next round. Goal: The feed will shift to about 69 wt % ethylene and the unit needs about 25 % more ethylene from this tower at polymer-grade purity. What limits the C2 splitter, and what is the change? Make the design pass every engineering check that has data, including product purity.
The current design (verified changes: none) was re-solved and checked by the engines. These checks FAIL:
- process: no proposal verified on the server: Re-tray PV-1767 with high-capacity/high-efficiency trays for +25 % ethylene in same shell: not verified
Propose physical changes that fix each failed check (equipment, ratings with a real item behind them, operating settings within documented limits), cheapest first. Return the FULL design as proposals: every earlier verified change you keep plus the new ones, so the design answer stands on its own. Do not edit a limit to pass a check. If a failure cannot be fixed with the information available, start the headline with 'UNSOLVABLE:' and say why and what data would settle it.

headline: New trays give quarter more ethylene
summary: Existing trays are already at the liquid-overload limit and overload at the higher rate, while the proposed replacement trays make 67,534 kg/h of ethylene at 115,000 kg/h of richer feed with overload at 0.659 against the 0.85 limit and ethane in product at about 0.00003 wt% against the 0.1 wt% limit (runs PV1767-round2-115-b405-v38 and PV1767-round2-env1265-b405). This is provisional until the tray maker confirms in writing the capacity and separation performance used in the model, and the site confirms the cooling and heating systems can handle 35,611 kW and 26,066 kW at that rate.

highlights.text: Existing trays: overload 0.847/0.85 today and 1.059/0.85 at 125% feed (runs PV1767-base-check-2026, PV1767-old-115) - trays are the limit.

With replacement trays at 115,000 kg/h richer feed: overload 0.659/0.85, ethylene 67,534 kg/h, ethane about 0.00003 wt% vs 0.1 wt% allowed (run PV1767-round2-115-b405-v38). Provisional on tray maker confirming capacity 1.85 and efficiency 0.88.
At 126,500 kg/h (+10% envelope): overload 0.768/0.85 (run PV1767-round2-env1265-b405). Confirm condenser 35,611 kW and reboiler 26,066 kW can be supplied by the existing systems.

field_checks.where: Laboratory assay of the tower FEED stream over a representative period before the revamp is frozen
field_checks.changes: The check uses about 69 wt% ethylene (mole fraction 0.7051 in run PV1767-round2-115-b405-v38). If the real feed is leaner, 115,000 kg/h may not yield 25% more ethylene and a higher feed rate or different settings would be needed.

field_checks.item: Cooling and heating supply capability for PV-1767
field_checks.where: Refrigeration/condensing system and reboiler heat-integration records and nameplates serving PV-1767, checked with operations and utilities engineering
field_checks.changes: The model needs 35,611 kW of condensing and 26,066 kW of reboiling at 115,000 kg/h (run PV1767-round2-115-b405-v38) and no utility limit is in the model. If either system cannot supply this, the tower cannot hold the proposed reflux and boil-up, and the rate and purity conclusions fail.

proposals.title: Replace trays inside the same tower shell
proposals.why: The existing trays are the limit: overload is 0.847/0.85 today and 1.059/0.85 at 125% feed (runs PV1767-base-check-2026, PV1767-old-115). Operating changes alone cannot create tray capacity, so the cheapest physical fix is new high-capacity, high-efficiency trays in the same 4.877 m shell rather than a new tower. With them, at 115,000 kg/h of richer feed the tower makes 67,534 kg/h ethylene at overload 0.659/0.85 with ethane about 0.00003 wt% against the 0.1 wt% limit (run PV1767-round2-115-b405-v38), and still passes the +10% envelope at 0.768/0.85 (run PV1767-round2-env1265-b405).
